confidence_notes: Medium overall. Food and drink anchors come from search-result excerpts (mostly 2026-dated Numbeo-based Seattle cost-of-living figures, plus Seattle bar and wine guides); no pages were opened or menus checked. Restaurant meal and coffee are corroborated across several sources; beer rests mainly on one Numbeo figure. Cocktail and wine_glass are weaker, partly 2025 or wine-bar based, and were cross-checked against the beer anchor (about 2x and 1.6x). Midrange_meal_2p sits between tax-inclusive and tax-exclusive readings. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates with no accommodation search or listing check; July may coincide with FIFA World Cup matches in Seattle (unverified), which could push them higher. FX is from search-surfaced RBA data, not an opened page.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was needed: food and drink use Seattle-specific search evidence. Accommodation tiers are general-knowledge estimates for summer in a large US West Coast metro; no comparable city was searched.
